summary.title: Driving Business Value with Applied AI & MLOps
summary.p1: I am an AI Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, specializing in Computer Vision, Backend Architecture, and Applied Generative AI. I partner with teams to turn ambitious concepts — such as geospatial satellite monitoring, real-time biometric attendance, and AI-driven CRM engines — into fast, scalable, and reliable products. I manage the entire lifecycle, from building the initial Data Pipelines to final Cloud Deployment.
summary.p2: My recent production work includes architecting Rabih CRM (a bilingual AI sales assistant), AgriVision (a geospatial satellite water monitoring system), and EmpVision (a real-time facial recognition attendance platform). These end-to-end solutions are fully deployed using production-grade tools like FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Whether you need an MLOps expert to deploy a custom Computer Vision model or a Backend Engineer for complex LLM workflows, I deliver robust systems that scale.
